title: Rockstar HR Manager Testifies in Union-Busting Trial
description: Rockstar Games faces a legal trial regarding union-busting allegations as an HR manager testifies about unionisation evidence.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Rockstar HR Manager Testifies in Ongoing Legal Trial

As the anticipation surrounding the release of *GTA6* continues to build globally, developer Rockstar Games is currently navigating a legal battle that has drawn significant attention from the gaming community and industry observers alike. According to reports from gaming outlet Eurogamer, new details have emerged from the ongoing Rockstar Games vs Garland & Others case.

### The HR Manager's Testimony

In the latest developments of the trial, one of Rockstar's HR managers took the stand as a witness. During the proceedings, the HR manager stated that he had "little interest" in evidence of unionisation efforts that had been sent to him by an anonymous employee prior to the company laying off a substantial number of union Discord members.

The lawsuit stems from the developer's controversial decision to lay off a large group of workers who were members of a union Discord channel. This wave of layoffs quickly triggered allegations of union-busting and subsequent legal action against the studio.

### Implications for the Industry and GTA6

While Rockstar remains focused on the development and upcoming release of *GTA6*, internal labor disputes highlight broader challenges facing the gaming industry regarding worker representation and management practices. Observers note that maintaining a stable and fair workplace is critical, especially during the high-pressure final stretches of developing a blockbuster title of this scale.

## Editor's Take
The legal proceedings involving Rockstar shed light on the complex relationship between major game developers and their workforce. Balancing large-scale production demands like *GTA6* with fair labor practices is an ongoing challenge for the industry, and the outcome of this trial could have lasting implications.
